context_title: a free trial offer for chatgpt plus available as of august 29, 2026 not limited to students or open source program participants

entries.query: a free trial offer for chatgpt plus available as of august 29, 2026 not limited to students or open source program participants
entries.answer:
As of August 29, 2026, there is no official evidence of a standing public ChatGPT Plus free trial that any user can simply start on demand.  OpenAI’s own Plus help page presents ChatGPT Plus as a $20/month subscription, while its promotional pages describe free trials only as limited campaigns tied to invites or partner codes rather than a universal offer.[1][2][3]

 What exists

OpenAI does officially support free, limitedduration ChatGPT subscription trials through referral invites, where eligible users can invite friends or family and the recipient can activate a trial for a paid plan such as ChatGPT Plus.  OpenAI also documents partner promotions in which a code from a partner may give a free trial, a discount, or another promotional rate, and those offers are separate from studentonly programs.[2][1]

 Who can use them

For referral trials, OpenAI says new users or users on the ChatGPT Free plan are generally eligible, while people who already have an existing paid plan may be ineligible depending on the campaign.  For partner promotions, OpenAI says some offers are exclusively for new ChatGPT Plus subscribers and may also have other campaignspecific eligibility rules such as region or paymentmethod restrictions.[1][2]

 Practical answer

So the answer is yes, but only in a limited sense: nonstudent, nonopensource free trial offers for ChatGPT Plus do exist officially, yet they are not a permanent public offer open to everyone at all times.  In practice, you would need either a valid invite from an eligible user or a valid partnerissued promo code, and the exact duration, availability, and requirements depend on the specific campaign.[2][1]

 What to watch for

If you find one of these offers, OpenAI says to verify at redemption whether the checkout shows the expected trial or $0.00 pricing before completing it, because some promotions require a payment method and most autorenew unless canceled before the trial ends.  OpenAI also notes that promo codes are generally singleuse, cannot be stacked, and may expire or be limited by region or account history.[1][2]
